description: The Trello plugin lets ChatGPT interact with your Trello boards, cards, and tasks using natural language. All communication between ChatGPT and Trello is encrypted for privacy and authenticated using security best practices. Once configured, you can manage your to-do’s without having to switch between tabs. Start tackling your Trello tasks with the help of ChatGPT!

defaultPrompt: Create a Trello board for the Italy travel plan we just discussed.
Show me any Trello cards due this week and book focus time on my calendar to get them done.
Review the tasks I have on my wedding planning board and add anything missing.
